description: prop:frobenius-gram-matrix published its largest convention-D Gram eigenvalue as 4.23033920. Its own declared witness (frobenius-gram-matrix-probe, q0Anchor proton) computes 4.230339225030225, which rounds to 4.23033923 -- five half-ulps away. The proton/muon pin gap moves this eigenvalue by ~4e-8 against a 2.5e-8 discrepancy, so magnitude alone could not distinguish a typo from a pin and it had to be computed. Rebuilding the whole 6x6 from the block's own symbolic entries at every registered pin gives 4.23033923 (proton), 4.23033940 (muon live) and 4.23033940 (retired): NO registered q0 produces 4.23033920, so it is a transcription error. Corrected in the block; the other five D entries (-0.75270211, 0, +0.75270211 x3) are right at the proton pin and unchanged. Four of the checker's five flags on this block are the convention-C spectrum, published deliberately as a labelled side-by-side comparison against the production convention D -- a legitimate publication class, not a defect. The C column is left untouched and remains unverified against an independent computation because convention C is excised and none exists; it does pass the one check its own numbers permit, its six eigenvalues multiplying to -0.189205215 against the published det G = -0.189205219144, a 2.0e-8 agreement consistent with six 8-decimal roundings. That is internal consistency, not verification. qou-i229.

convention_C_column_internal_check.status: internal consistency only -- NOT verified, and the C figures are deliberately NOT transcribed into this witness; see the probe docstring

caveats: The C column is NOT verified. Convention C is excised, so no independent computation of it exists in the corpus. The 2.0e-8 figure recorded here is the published eigenvalues multiplied against the published determinant -- internal consistency, which a set of wrong-but-consistent numbers would also pass.
Asserts the CORRECTED state, not the defect. A probe that asserts a defect goes red the moment the fix lands -- the muon_pin_three_values failure qou-i229 already records.
Says nothing about the signature reading; this block already settled that and withdrew its earlier indefinite/Lorentzian claim in 748ba9b1.
